ai_will_do.doc: ai_will_do has to be 10 for AI to do it (with >=99 Meritocracy).

cost.doc: Cost in meritocracy of enacting the decree

duration.doc: Duration in days of the modifier of the decree

effect.doc: Effects to run when the decree is enacted

modifier.doc: Modifiers active during the duration of the decree

potential.doc: If false the decree will not appear

removed_effect.doc: Effects to run when the decree is expired

trigger.doc: If false you will not be able to take the decree

factor.doc: Base weight multiplier in the enclosing weight/AI block.
